method: RI-MTH07 Comparison method steps 1-5, applied exhaustively over every model W1-19's status file lists as an output. ARBITRATION §3 CONSUMPTION.
note: RI-MTH07 §B1: a harness return value is not an observable. Where the observable below is a quest-offer DECISION or a refusal string, that is an entity-side gate outcome the player would meet as a closed door, not the model's own return value.

models.model: The act/stakes graph and the 32 quest definitions (game/data/quests/mainline*.json)
models.consumer: game/src/sim/quest/defs.js -> QuestBook -> QuestEngine.open()/resolve(); game/src/engine.js:236-238 constructs it at boot
models.perturbation: drop-topic sabotage (builder's own) vs baseline, same seed
models.observed_b: 0/29 opened, 0 journal entries, refusal string 'the topic "the drowned tally" has not come up yet'

models.model: giver.disposition_min against the derived disposition register
models.consumer: game/src/sim/quest/gate.js canOffer() line 156-158, reading QuestEngine.context().dispositions (a derived view since W1-07 r4)
models.perturbation: character signature, one field moved (upbringing), everything else held fixed

models.model: The 174 faction_reputation deltas the mainline grants
models.consumer: machine.js _applyConsequences -> QuestEngine._dispositionToward -> the movable `faction` term -> gate.js canOffer()
models.perturbation: before/after Q-MAIN-01 res_carry, saxhleel/interior, watching salt-factor-neloth-vaun

models.model: The point-of-no-return flag set and its locks/unlocks
models.consumer: gate.js opens_by/closed_by; walk-back attempts refused live
models.observed_b: 4/4 walk-back attempts refused, 0 modals, 0 text events

models.model: The journal entries (253 across the two chains)
models.consumer: sim/quest/journal.js write() -> engine ctx.journal -> game/src/ui/screens/text.js drawJournal(), elements of kind `journal_entry`
models.perturbation: not separately perturbed; the entries are drawn from the same store the trace reads and the UI screen enumerates them as elements

models.model: opens_by.topic — the topic gate's SUPPLY side (31 distinct prose keywords)
models.consumer: gate.js:153 reads it; NOTHING IN THE WORLD WRITES IT. The only writers of sim.quest.topicsKnown are machine.js:424/465 (hooks and entry_topics, all dashed slugs), magic/apply.js:593 (a speak-with-dead effect) and window.__HARNESS.learnTopic().
models.perturbation: cold boot, nothing learned through the harness
models.model_value_a: n/a — no world-side value can be produced
models.observed_a: 0/32 main quests offerable; 32/32 blocked on the topic gate; topicsKnown length 0
models.orphan_shape: orphan predicate (RI-MTH07 §A row 3) — the rule is only reachable by telling the engine what it should have observed

models.model: opens_by.overheard_from — the three NPCs who carry the rumour that starts the main quest
models.consumer: NONE. `grep -rn overheard_from game/src/ --include=*.js` returns 0 outside the harness.
models.observed_a: declared on 3 of 32 main quests; 0 code consumers; 0 rumour lines anywhere in game/data/dialogue/** name a main-quest noun

models.model: q.directions — 32 prose wayfinding strings, 100% coverage, the AR-2 defence
models.consumer: game/src/sim/quest/defs.js validation only (length >= 20, banned-prose scan). Never rendered, never spoken, never written into a journal entry: journal.js write() copies `def.text` and nothing else.
models.observed_a: 0 of 32 mainline `directions` strings appear verbatim in any journal entry of their own quest; 3 of 32 share even a 40-character window
models.orphan_shape: orphan text (RI-JRN07 CONSUMPTION §4, the fourth shape) — authored, validated, carried through the model, never drawn

models.model: hooks.json entry_topics — the 32 AddTopic edges W1-19 appended
models.consumer: machine.js _write() fires them on the journal write at the declared index
models.observed_a: mechanically live, but 23 of 32 seed only the topic that opens the quest doing the seeding (Q-MAIN-nn#10 adds the topic Q-MAIN-nn's own opens_by demands) and 5 seed nothing that any quest asks for; only 4 edges point forward
models.orphan_shape: the edge fires and reaches nothing reachable — a supply graph with no source node

models.consumer: claimed in the file's own engine_notes as game/src/character/converse.js infoFor(); NOT VERIFIED by this critic. Landed untracked at 12:00Z, during this measurement.
models.observed_a: 12 topics, 4 knowledge-gated, race- and upbringing-filtered infos present on disk
models.note: Declared unmeasured rather than assumed. Ixtu-meer is unreachable in play for the independent reason above, so no player can reach this conversation today regardless of whether converse.js reads it.

consequence: RI-MTH07 §B3 and ARBITRATION §3: a model with no demonstrated world-side consumer is unmeasurable => 0 for its dimension. The four zeros above are the discovery half of quests.mainline.acts; they are recorded in the verdict's status_reasons and are the subject of the single biggest gap.
